description: Master Django ORM, defining models, migrations, and relationships

slides.title: Introduction to Models
slides.content:
# Django Models 🗄️

Models are Python classes that define your database structure!

## What you'll learn:
- **ORM Basics** - Object-Relational Mapping
- **Defining Models** - Fields and options
- **Migrations** - Database schema changes
- **Relationships** - ForeignKey, ManyToMany
- **Queries** - CRUD operations

## Why Use Models?

```python
# Without ORM (raw SQL)
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM articles WHERE id = %s", [5])
row = cursor.fetchone()

# With Django ORM
article = Article.objects.get(id=5)
```

> 💡 **The ORM translates Python to SQL!** You write Python, Django generates optimized SQL.

## Model = Database Table

```python
class Article(models.Model):    # → articles table
    title = models.CharField()   # → title column
    content = models.TextField() # → content column
```

slides.title: Defining Models
slides.content:
# Creating Models 📝

## Basic Model

```python
from django.db import models

class Article(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    content = models.TextField()
    published = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    
    def __str__(self):
        return self.title
```

## Common Field Types

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `CharField` | Short text (max_length required) |
| `TextField` | Long text |
| `IntegerField` | Integer |
| `FloatField` | Decimal number |
| `BooleanField` | True/False |
| `DateField` | Date |
| `DateTimeField` | Date and time |
| `EmailField` | Validated email |
| `URLField` | Validated URL |
| `ImageField` | Image upload |
| `FileField` | File upload |

## Field Options

```python
title = models.CharField(
    max_length=200,
    blank=True,       # Can be empty in forms
    null=True,        # Can be NULL in database
    default='Draft',  # Default value
    unique=True,      # Must be unique
)
```

slides.title: Database Migrations
slides.content:
# Migrations 🔄

Migrations track changes to your models and apply them to the database.

## Migration Workflow

```bash
# 1. Make changes to models.py

# 2. Create migration files
python manage.py makemigrations

# 3. Apply migrations to database
python manage.py migrate
```

## Migration Commands

```bash
# See migration status
python manage.py showmigrations

# See SQL for a migration
python manage.py sqlmigrate blog 0001

# Rollback to specific migration
python manage.py migrate blog 0001

# Rollback all migrations
python manage.py migrate blog zero
```

## What Migrations Handle

- ✅ Creating tables
- ✅ Adding/removing columns
- ✅ Changing field types
- ✅ Creating indexes
- ✅ Adding constraints

> 💡 **Always commit migration files to version control!** They're essential for team collaboration.

> ⚠️ **Never delete migrations manually** unless you know what you're doing!

slides.title: Model Relationships
slides.content:
# Relationships 🔗

## ForeignKey (One-to-Many)

```python
class Category(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)

class Article(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    category = models.ForeignKey(
        Category,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,  # Delete articles if category deleted
        related_name='articles'    # category.articles.all()
    )
```

## on_delete Options

| Option | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| `CASCADE` | Delete related objects |
| `PROTECT` | Prevent deletion |
| `SET_NULL` | Set to NULL |
| `SET_DEFAULT` | Set to default |
| `DO_NOTHING` | Do nothing |

## ManyToManyField

```python
class Tag(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=50)

class Article(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    tags = models.ManyToManyField(Tag, related_name='articles')
```

## OneToOneField

```python
class Profile(models.Model):
    user = models.OneToOneField(
        User,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE
    )
    bio = models.TextField()
```

slides.title: Querying Data
slides.content:
# QuerySet API 🔍

## Basic Queries

```python
# Get all objects
articles = Article.objects.all()

# Get single object
article = Article.objects.get(id=5)

# Filter objects
active = Article.objects.filter(is_active=True)
python_articles = Article.objects.filter(title__contains='Python')

# Exclude objects  
no_drafts = Article.objects.exclude(status='draft')

# First/Last
first = Article.objects.first()
last = Article.objects.last()
```

## Field Lookups

```python
# Comparison
Article.objects.filter(views__gt=100)    # Greater than
Article.objects.filter(views__gte=100)   # Greater than or equal
Article.objects.filter(views__lt=100)    # Less than
Article.objects.filter(views__lte=100)   # Less than or equal

# Text
Article.objects.filter(title__contains='python')     # Case sensitive
Article.objects.filter(title__icontains='python')    # Case insensitive
Article.objects.filter(title__startswith='How')
Article.objects.filter(title__endswith='?')

# Date
Article.objects.filter(published__year=2024)
Article.objects.filter(published__month=3)
```

slides.title: CRUD Operations
slides.content:
# Create, Read, Update, Delete 📊

## Create

```python
# Method 1: create()
article = Article.objects.create(
    title='My Article',
    content='Hello World'
)

# Method 2: save()
article = Article(title='My Article', content='Hello')
article.save()

# Bulk create
Article.objects.bulk_create([
    Article(title='Article 1'),
    Article(title='Article 2'),
])
```

## Read

```python
article = Article.objects.get(pk=5)  # Single object
articles = Article.objects.all()      # All objects
filtered = Article.objects.filter(is_active=True)
```

## Update

```python
# Single object
article = Article.objects.get(pk=5)
article.title = 'New Title'
article.save()

# Bulk update
Article.objects.filter(is_active=False).update(is_active=True)
```

## Delete

```python
# Single object
article = Article.objects.get(pk=5)
article.delete()

# Bulk delete
Article.objects.filter(status='draft').delete()
```

slides.title: Advanced Queries
slides.content:
# Advanced QuerySet Features 🚀

## Ordering

```python
# Ascending
Article.objects.order_by('title')

# Descending
Article.objects.order_by('-published')

# Multiple fields
Article.objects.order_by('category', '-published')
```

## Aggregation

```python
from django.db.models import Count, Avg, Sum, Max, Min

# Count
count = Article.objects.count()

# Aggregate
stats = Article.objects.aggregate(
    total=Count('id'),
    avg_views=Avg('views'),
    max_views=Max('views')
)
# {'total': 100, 'avg_views': 50.5, 'max_views': 1000}
```

## Related Objects

```python
# Forward relation
article = Article.objects.get(pk=5)
category_name = article.category.name

# Reverse relation
category = Category.objects.get(pk=1)
category_articles = category.articles.all()

# Prefetch for performance
articles = Article.objects.prefetch_related('tags').all()

# Select related (ForeignKey)
articles = Article.objects.select_related('category').all()
```
